entities.name: János Boldóczki
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: János Boldóczki was a Hungarian politician, who served as Minister of Foreign Affairs between 1953 and 1956. He was member of the Hungarian Communist Party since 1944. From 1950 he was the Hungarian ambassador to Czechoslovakia and from 1956 to the Soviet Union. He kept his position during the Hungarian Revolution of 1956. After that Boldóczki served as ambassador to Mongolia.
